expect: main.cf (5:2) error: cannot initialize 'const int32**' from 'int32**': const is added to a pointer's pointee only when every pointer above it points to const too
Types/PointerLayerConstAddedUnderMutable.reason: BUG-321: adding const below a mutable layer would let a pointer to const be stored as mutable; the error spells each layer's const and says why

expect: main.cf (9:2) error: cannot initialize 'const Box**' from 'Box const**': dropping const is not allowed
Types/PointerLayerConstDropped.reason: BUG-321: a const map's Find gives a pointer to a const Box*; dropping that const is refused, and the two types print differently (they used to both print 'const Box**')

Platform/SubsystemUnknown.reason: --subsystem names one of the two subsystems; anything else is a clear command-line error, never a console build

expect: main.cf (2:18) error: the string has 4 characters: more than 'char8[3]' holds
Types/CharArrayStringTooLong.reason: a string literal starts a character array only when its characters fit (BUG-314); a longer one is an error naming both sizes, never a silent cut

expect: main.cf (2:19) error: a string of 'char8' units starts only a 'char8' array, not 'char16[4]'
Types/CharArrayStringWidth.reason: a string literal's unit width must match the array's character type (BUG-314): a plain literal does not start a char16 array

expect: main.cf (5:17) error: the conversion from 'int64' to 'int16' may change the value
Diagnostics/WerrorFails.reason: -Werror makes the narrowing warning an error, and the build fails (B22).

expect: UuidOfNegative.cf (3:13) error: __uuidof: type not found: Missing
Types/UuidOfNegative.reason: Every type has a UUID (D-43), so __uuidof fails only for a name that is not a type, and says which

Namespaces/OpenNamespaceDuplicate.reason: a namespace member defined in two files is a real collision and must produce a clear duplicate-definition error, not silently merge or link twice

Types/SizeOfIncompleteType.reason: sizeof of a forward-declared (incomplete) type is not a compile-time constant: it must be a clear compile error, never a crash and never a silent zero

expect: bit_count works on an integer or a packed integer vector, not a 'float'
Operators/BitIntrinsicNeedsInteger.reason: the bit intrinsics count and move integer bits: a float operand is a clear error naming the intrinsic and the type

Operators/BitIntrinsicArgumentCount.reason: a rotation needs the value and the count: a wrong argument count names the intrinsic and both counts
